preamble: Deaffrication with loss of glottalization: the lateral ejective affricate [tɬʼ] becomes the voiceless lateral fricative [ɬ]. Stem-final *tɬʼ is among the commonest stem-final ejectives in Proto-Athabaskan and splits three ways: ɬ in Hupa, Tolowa, Deg Xinag, Wailaki, Western Apache, Jicarilla and partly Ahtna; l in Navajo; plain tɬ in Lower Tanana (Tanacross is mixed). Denaʼina keeps the ejective (nqutlʼ 'cloudberry').

languageExamples.language: Proto-Athabaskan to Pacific Coast, Apachean and Alaskan languages
